Name: Anime Eyes Replacement - Big Eyes (Content Patcher)
Author: DegenerateFreak
Description:
Replaces the player's sprite with bigger, anime-like eyes.

It works as normal with choosing eye colours etc. It works for all farmer sprites - male, female, and the bald versions of both (which have unique sprite sheets, hence why I mention it).
It won't be compatible with other mods that change the farmer sprites, but you're welcome to make modifications if you credit me.

KNOWN ISSUES: Blinking, and some other animations/images, look a bit weird, but otherwise it looks fine.

If you have any problems, suggestions, etc, please comment on this mod page.

This mod requires the latest Stardew version (December 2020), SMAPI, and Content Patcher.
Put the[i] [CP] Anime Eyes[/i] folder into your [i]Mods[/i] folder to install, remove the same one to uninstall.

[b]Update, May 2024: This mod has been updated for version 1.6. [/b]You can download the new version in files. Make sure to remove or replace the old version from your Mods folder if you still had it.
Note: You are welcome to make edits if you want these eyes to work with other farmer sprite modifications.

Downloads.Description:
For Stardew Valley version 1.6. To install, unzip and put the folder into your Mods folder. To uninstall, remove the folder from your Mods folder. Requires Content Patcher.
Make sure to remove or replace previous versions.
